title: Fixing a Minor Mistake in the Theory of Stochastic Integration and Differential Equations
abstract: When considering stochastic integration and the theory of stochastic differential equations, P. Protter's textbook \cite{protter} undoubtedly is a main piece of standard literature. Not only is it well-written, but it also contains various profound results regarding these fields. Unfortunately, Theorem 12 of Chapter V, which presents an equivalence to uniform convergence on compacts in probability, is found to be incorrect. Given that numerous important results rely on this theorem, this paper aims to present a corrected version of it.
